label: Calloway, late runs — the full inventory, read aloud

purpose.value: Calloway reads the complete vault inventory aloud in full catalog language — procedure as protest: the diplomatic banking network is still holding the hero's haul, and every 'instrument of evil' gets its honest name, at length, while he stands there.

emotionalProgression.note: 'Vault contents, in full, as of this morning. I will read them. You will stand there. It is the only part of my job I have changed.'
Every item gets its full description, no abbreviations — the list doesn't lie, and the list is what's true.

notes: The escalation endpoint for the ledger arc: the dry discrepancy question has become the whole ledger, read aloud without being asked. She still never mislabels an item, and she still only suspects the book's genre — no book reference even now. The last honest attempt. The hero's reply will still be some variant of 'At last, the enemy respects me.' — that framing belongs to his side of the exchange (notes only), never to an NPC line. Never validate the hero's prophecy framing: there is no canon fact supporting 'the realms are evil', and that absence is itself the guard.
